name: NSW Medical Energy Rebate
summary: Electricity bill credit for NSW concession card holders who, or whose household member, cannot self-regulate body temperature.
who: Hold a Pensioner Concession Card, Health Care Card, Low Income Health Care Card or DVA Veteran Gold Card
You or someone living with you cannot self-regulate body temperature and meets the qualifying conditions
how: Complete the form with your medical practitioner
Contact your electricity retailer and provide them with a copy of your completed form.
catches: The page does not state the dollar amount.

source.label: Service NSW: Apply for the Medical Energy Rebate (retail customers)

evidence.quote: Health Care Card issued by Services Australia
meets at least one Primary Qualifying Condition and at least one Secondary Qualifying Condition.
